run_post_grad_passes: run post_grad_passes on a GraphModule to apply dead code elimination, pattern matching, and inplace rewrites
remove_noop_ops: remove noop operations like redundant slices, repeats, views, and copies from an FX graph
reinplace_inplaceable_ops: reinplace inplaceable operations in an FX graph where no downstream view observers exist
move_constructors_to_cuda: move cpu tensor constructor nodes to cuda when all downstream users can safely run on cuda
register_lowering_pattern: register an aten-to-inductor-IR replacement pattern using CallFunction graph matching
